parameters.query:
SELECT id, email, whatsapp
FROM usuarios
WHERE (LOWER(email) = LOWER($1) OR whatsapp = $2)
  AND ($3::int IS NULL OR id != $3::int)
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE usuarios
SET
  nome = $1,
  email = $2,
  whatsapp = $3,
  role = $4,
  ativo = $5,
  password_hash = CASE
    WHEN $6 != '' THEN crypt($6, gen_salt('bf'))
    ELSE password_hash
  END
WHERE id = $7
RETURNING id, nome, email, whatsapp, avatar_url, role, ativo;
